summary: R1-R5 are a window-only change confined to the apps feature. The sidebar owns its own active tab as plain useState (never src/App.tsx, as revision 3 required), so clicking a rail icon just sets that tab and calls the onTogglePane callback the sidebar already receives. A fixed Projects | Files strip sits at the top of the expanded pane, built on the already-installed jattac.libs.web.zest-tabs (USR-001) through a thin SidebarTabs adapter that adds only the Enter/Space activation and the role=tabpanel wiring the library lacks; the library already gives role=tablist/role=tab, aria-selected, roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/Right selection and a focus ring. The existing Home row and app/terminal rows move verbatim into a memoised SidebarProjects child, and both panels stay mounted after first use, toggled with the hidden attribute. A tab switch is therefore O(1): it flips two hidden flags and the pill, never reconciles the 500-row Projects list and never re-reads a folder. The Files panel is mounted lazily on first use so opening on Projects costs no explorer listing. The explorer ReactNode/ExplorerPanel and root.ts are untouched, and every selection handler is left alone so nothing switches the tab by itself. No Rust command, src/api call, capability, CSP change, npm/crate dependency, version bump or localStorage key is added; the Files header name, roll-up dot, remembered tab and Ctrl+Shift+E are revision 2 and are not built here.

additions.title: Mount the Files panel on first use and keep it once shown
additions.why: Opening the app on Projects should not read a folder for a tab nobody opened, and returning to Files should not cost the same folder read or lose the expanded tree.
acceptance: Starting on the Projects tab issues no explorer listing request for the Files panel.
Opening the Files tab for the first time issues exactly one listing for the current root.
After Files has been shown once, switching to Projects and back with the pane still expanded shows the same folder and expanded levels without a new listing request.

additions.title: Freeze today's sidebar lists before the tab change
additions.why: The sidebar and its rail are already in use, so their current Home row, app rows, terminal rows and status dots must be pinned in tests before the tab layout is introduced (USR-004).
acceptance: Characterisation tests assert the expanded Home row, every app row, every terminal row and the roll-up status dots.
Characterisation tests assert the rail keeps Expand, Home and every app initial with its status dot.
Those assertions pass against the sidebar before the tab change and after it, except where the new tab strip and rail tab icons are intentionally added.
